exam_scheme.note: The Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test (JTET / JHTET) is conducted by the Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC), Ranchi under the Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test Rules, 2024 (Jharkhand Shikshak Patrata Pariksha Niyamavali, 2024, Notification No. 487 dated 26.03.2024) and NCTE guidelines. The examination consists of two levels: Level 1 for teaching Classes 1 to 5 (Primary Level) and Level 2 for teaching Classes 6 to 8 (Upper Primary Level). Each level consists of a single integrated composite paper of 150 objective multiple-choice questions (150 marks) of 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes) duration, administered on OMR sheets. There is no negative marking. Qualifying candidates receive a JTET certificate with lifetime validity, conferring eligibility for appointment as Sahayak Acharya (Assistant Teachers) in Jharkhand elementary schools.

competition_benchmarks.note: Historical examination and qualifying candidate figures documented from official Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC) announcements and state education department releases. JTET was previously conducted in 2013 and 2016, followed by a prolonged hiatus until the notification of the 2024/2026 cycle under revised NCTE rules for filling over 26,000 Sahayak Acharya vacancies.
